note: Played when the player stops on an undiscovered star. Topics match the actual clip footage (stars.tsv windows were first-guess; labels follow what ships in game/stars/).

stars.01_queen: This star is about the queen — the huge mother of the colony who lays the eggs nurses carry to the nursery.
stars.02_larvae: This star is about larvae — soft white babies that nurse ants feed and carry in the nursery.
stars.03_pupae: This star is about pupae — young ants changing shape — and how the colony grows tiny workers, big workers, and soldiers.
stars.04_fungus: This star is about the fungus garden — the soft white farm leafcutters grow for food.
stars.05_forage: This star is about leaf cutting and the trails foragers follow outside.
stars.06_pheromone: This star is about scent trails — how leafcutter ants talk without words using pheromones.
stars.07_soldiers: This star is about soldier ants — big jaws that guard and defend the colony.
stars.08_waste: This star is about the underground fungal garden chambers where leafcutters farm their food.
stars.09_labor: This star is about workers slicing leaf pieces and carrying them home to feed the fungus.
stars.10_bacteria: This star is about worker ants tending the fungus so the garden stays healthy.
stars.11_architecture: This star is about desert leafcutters — they farm fungus and cut leaves too.
stars.12_invaders: This star is about invaders — when something attacks the nest, ants swarm to fight and defend.
